payload.title: Candidate-line inventory from source for labeling
payload.description:
Build the candidate-line inventory that labeling batches work from. It comes from the source, not from scanner output, so labels do not inherit scanner behavior.

## Behavior

- Input: repo key, concept (`email`), and the scope file list.
- Output: `tests/benchmark/repos/<repo>/annotations/packets/<concept>-candidates.yaml`, one entry per line: file, line, the line text.
- A line is a candidate when an identifier, property key, string, or comment on it contains `email`, `e_mail`, `mail_to`, `mailto`, `recipient`, `sender`, or `from_address` in any case or separator style. The token list lives in a config file so other concepts reuse the script.
- Deterministic and rerunnable at the pinned commit.

## Done when

Running it on `ghost` and `saleor` scopes produces candidate files, and a spot check of three files finds no email-related line missing.
